_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture - a GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/{n} response as GithubApiMilestone. Never captured from a real repository. Same shape as one element of milestone-list.json: the endpoint returns no extra fields, so the difference between the list and the detail tool is what the SERVER chooses to map, not what GitHub sends. See _quirks.

_quirks.identical-api-shape: GithubApiMilestone is returned by three endpoints - search results (nested in an issue), the milestone list, and this one. Only get_github_milestone maps open_issues/closed_issues through; the compact shape drops them.
_quirks.progress: open_issues 4 + closed_issues 11 = 15 issues, 73% closed. These two fields are the only reason get_github_milestone returns more than the list tool - see ../../../04-contracts/data-schemas.md#milestone-detail.
_quirks.counts-exclude-nothing: GitHub counts pull requests in these totals as well as issues, so they may exceed what list_github_issues reports for the same milestone.
